summary: Explains ansible.netcommon.parse_xml (2.5+) for turning network device XML output into JSON with a YAML spec using top and XPath items, with an example for show vlan | display xml.
questions: How do I parse XML output from a network device in Ansible?
How do I write a parse_xml spec?

answer_card.title: Parsing XML output with parse_xml
answer_card.answer_md:
```jinja
{{ output | ansible.netcommon.parse_xml('path/to/spec') }}
```

Spec example:

```yaml
keys:
  vlans:
    value: "{{ vlan }}"
    top: configuration/vlans/vlan
    items:
      vlan_id: vlan-id
      name: name
      desc: description
      state: ".[@inactive='inactive']"
```

Returns a list of VLAN hashes.
